en: I bow to the Lord of Rādhikā, who is praised by the four-faced Brahmā and others, lauded by all the devotees of the Lord, and accompanied by Halāyudha (Balarāma) and his followers. 1.
I bow to the Lord of Rādhikā, who subdued the demon Kālaka along with the Bakas and others, together with the cowherds, cowherd boys, and their protectors, and whose dark locks are enchanting. 2.
I bow to the Lord of Rādhikā, who humbles the pride of the King of the Gods, shatters the delusion of Brahmā, and delights the women of Vraja. 3.
I bow to the Lord of Rādhikā, who adorns himself with peacock feathers, who wears fragments of the tusks of lordly elephants, and who executed the cruel Kaṃsa. 4.
I bow to the Lord of Rādhikā, who bestowed wives upon the brāhmaṇas, who created the abode of Sudāmā, and who took away the celestial trees. 5.
I bow to the Lord of Rādhikā, who brings victory to Dhanañjaya, who causes the destruction of the great army, and who removes the suffering of the Grandfather (Brahmā). 6.
I bow to the Lord of Rādhikā, who brought about the curse of the King of Sages, who carried away the daughter of the Yadu clan, and who descended to remove the burden of the earth.
I bow to the Lord of Rādhikā, who reclines at the foot of a beautiful tree, who grants liberation to the enemy of beasts (the lion), and who manifests his own abode through his divine power. 8.
A person who, being composed, always joyfully recites this beneficial "Exalted Octad" is swiftly liberated from birth, old age, and other such afflictions. (9)
Thus ends the Śrī Kṛṣṇāṣṭaka composed by the venerable Paramahaṃsa Brahmānanda.
